tool.journal_query.title: Journal Query
tool.journal_query.description: Read-only structured query of journald logs (journalctl -o json) by unit, time window, priority, regex and count.
tool.journal_follow.title: Journal Follow
tool.journal_follow.description: Bounded journald subscription (journalctl --follow -o json) until 1000 entries or 30 seconds, returning the collected batch.
tool.journal_last_boot.title: Last Boot Log
tool.journal_last_boot.description: Read-only last 50 journald entries from the previous boot (journalctl -b -1 -o json).
